description: Nigeria - National Roads is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by GRID3. Nigeria National Roads Network including Major Roads, Residential Roads, Tertiary Roads and Track Roads. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher GRID3. Its tags are geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
